## Activity

In May 2024, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 441 captures. This activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below. The capture total should be reviewed alongside the number of images available for grading and the subsequent referral outcomes.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed during May 2024, 12 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.7 per cent. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be monitored and addressed through the appropriate operational process. Maintaining a clear record of these issues will support review of image quality at Harbour Eye Clinic.

## Grading

Grading identified 122 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2 days. This result should be considered with the activity volume and image-quality findings when reviewing the service’s performance for May 2024. Continued attention to timely grading and the prompt recording of equipment concerns is requested.
